title: CA Bus & Prof Code §21606 — junk dealer / recycler written record
amended: Amended by Stats. 2025, Ch. 694, Sec. 1 (AB 476). Effective January 1, 2026.
why: Full current text retrieved, and the amending act is named on the source page. The two newest requirements — the TIME of the transaction and the EMPLOYEE who handled it — come from AB 476 and are less than a year old, so any earlier advice she was given about this section predates them.

title: CA Bus & Prof Code §21608.5 — nonferrous material: payment, ID, photographs, thumbprint
amended: Source states: Amended by Stats. 2012, Ch. 531, Sec. 1.5 (AB 1508), effective January 1, 2013.
why: MARKED DISPUTED ON PURPOSE, and not because the rule is doubted. The only full text found was on a page whose own footer says it was last modified in 2018, and AB 476 amended neighbouring sections of this article in 2025. A twelve-year-old reading of a section in an article that was amended last year is exactly the kind of source that should not drive a green tick. Confirm against leginfo.legislature.ca.gov before acting on the payment timing or the thumbprint.
